attackers_goals: Deliver malware or exfiltrate data via auto-download file-sharing links.
description: The email contains unusual file-sharing link(s) for mailbox owner.
investigative_actions: Analyze the linked file(s) to determine if they pose any security risk. Check the sender's communication history within the organization. Analyze the file reputation using sandbox or threat intelligence sources. Verify whether similar links were sent to other users.
